messages:
lee: FYI we're scheduling a kernel+quant roll tonight in the quiet window. small bake, conservative canary.
pat: window?
lee: 23:45-00:10 UTC. quiesce 3m, swap 8m, validate 10m. order: eu -> na -> ap.
ana: spelling note: it's ana, not 'ana' but whatever :grin: also who's owner?
lee: owners=pat,ana,lee. deploy-bot, please add surge_protection and preflight slice=4%.
deploy-bot: @lee scheduled 4481234567 for 23:45 UTC. surge_protection=enabled. preflight slice=4%.
sre-oncall: I'll watch traces and be ready to pin. add me to incident rota.
pat: rollback criteria: p95 > 1.8x baseline for 4m OR error rate >0.8% for 3m OR quant-asserts >0.3% on smoke. auto-pin TTL=3600s.
lee: preflight command (staging): ./ci/preflight --smoke canonical_prompts --slice 4 --timeout 600
deploy-bot: preflight started. logs -> https://ci.internal/logs/4481234567

deploy-bot: preflight passed. smoke regressions=0. kv_misses=0.12%
pat: starting eu swap. keep 5m bake.
deploy-bot: eu swap done. smoke ok.
sre-oncall: eu p95 within +6% baseline. continuing.
deploy-bot: starting na swap.
deploy-bot: na reported brief p95 blip 1.7x for 90s, auto-throttle engaged, traffic shifted to fallback variant.
lee: looks borderline but under our rollback gate. continue but keep an eye.
pat: capture kernel logs and driver build id from that host.
sre-oncall: collecting traces. no persistent errors. will hold ap until na stabilizes.
deploy-bot: na bake complete, no rollback triggered. starting ap swap.
deploy-bot: ap swap completed. overall rollout successful.
lee: great work. follow-ups: 1) add per-driver telemetry to detect symbol mismatch, 2) add slightly tighter throttle next run, 3) doc kernel/quant bundle mapping in repo.
pat: updating release notes: "runtime: kernel v7.4 + quant v4.5 - KV cache and batching fixes. staged rollout completed; no rollbacks."
lee: closing deploy ticket. thanks everyone. :tada:
